attributes.title: 2027 SNMMI Mid-Winter Meeting
attributes.organizer: Society of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging
attributes.summary:
San Francisco hosts this smaller SNMMI meeting on February 4 to 6, 2027, with a Thursday image interpretation session on theranostics imaging. That session is labeled non-CE, so don't count it toward your hours. Other registration categories do include CE, though the credit total is not published yet and the full program is still to come.

Physician members pay $635 through January 5, 2027, then $785; nonmembers pay $1,570, then $1,960. Residents who are members attend free. The physician room block at the Hilton San Francisco Union Square is $229, available until January 7, 2027.
